notes: Module L9-SC55311G-20PPI5: 1x9 Bi-Di, 5V supply, Industrial operating case temperature -40°C to +85°C (Note 2), Simplex SC, 20 km reach per Order Information. Launch power, sensitivity, and max input power rows note 20 km. Central wavelength 1510–1550–1590 nm (1550 DFB). Output spectrum width Δλ max 1 nm (DFB-LD). Receiver operating wavelength 1260–1610 nm. Signal detect range -38 to -23 dBm. Data rate in Recommended Operating Conditions: 10–1250–1500 Mbps. Features also state up to 0.55 Km on 62.5/125 μm MMF and up to 60 Km on 9/125 μm SMF for the product family; SC/ST/FC single optical interface listed in Features. Class 1 laser IEC 825 compliant.
